desc:
Your goal is to escape!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Project: Escape Room is a difficult escape room game where you will find yourself stuck in different unique maps. Your goal is to escape, solving puzzles and using the environment to your advantage!

⚠️This game is much more challenging than other escape room games, expect to be tested!
✅If you are new to escape rooms, consider trying beginner mode!
🎮Play solo or with a group of up to 5 players!
🔐There are currently 11 maps with many more to come!

Private servers support up to 10 player groups!

❗Join the group for updates and sneak peeks! https://www.roblox.com/communities/35660393/Serif-Games

Make sure to like 👍 and favorite ⭐ if you enjoyed, this greatly supports development! Thank you!
